name: linkedin-ai-agent
description: Autonomous AI agent for Market Intelligence content creation

scripts.refresh: rm -rf node_modules && npm install && npm run build
scripts.appversion: echo "version is $(npm pkg get version)" | tr -d '"'
scripts.build: echo && echo \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* running build: build_alpha build_admin build_html build_js \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* \* && npm run build_alpha && npm run build_admin && npm run build_html && npm run build_js && npm run pages && echo installed version $npm_package_name-$npm_package_version && V=$(npm pkg get version --workspaces=false | tr -d '"') && echo $V >.build && CSSVERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').config.cssversion") && echo "package version is $(cat .build)-$CSSVERSION"
scripts.production: npm ci --ignore-scripts --omit=dev && npm run getvars && NODE_ENV=production npm run start
scripts.nonprod: npm run getvars && NODE_ENV=nonprod npm run nodemon
scripts.dev: export $(cat .env.pg.local | xargs) && npm run getvars && NODE_ENV=dev DEV_BYPASS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3001,http://127.0.0.1:3001,http://172.16.11.101:3001 DEV_BYPASS_SUB="***REMOVED***" npm run nodemon
scripts.cloudflared: echo mobile testing, navigate to https://dev.majikl.net && dig https://dev.majikl.net && cloudflared tunnel run linkedin-dev
scripts.s-listen: npm run s-login && stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3001/api/payments/webhook
scripts.extract-v: unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d .. && v=$(basename $(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip | tail -1));v=${v##*-};v=${v%.zip} && mkdir -p /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && npm version $v && npm run build; unzip -l "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)"|$(which grep) 'scripts/testing' >/dev/null && echo && echo found scripts/testing --\> extracting to git \"Testing\" project
scripts.extractd: unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d .. && v=$(basename $(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip | tail -1));v=${v##*-};v=${v%.zip} && mkdir -p /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && echo "version is unchanged: $(npm pkg get version)"
scripts.run-tests-1: for tc in $(OUTPUT="$(unzip -l "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)"|$(which grep) 'scripts/testing')" bash -c 'awk "{ path=\$NF; n=split(path,a,\"\\/\"); for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if(a[i]==\"scripts\" && a[i+1]==\"testing\" && index(a[i+2],\"test-\")==1) print a[i+2]; }" <<< \"$OUTPUT\"');do echo npm run batch-test -- "$tc";done
scripts.run-tests: APPVERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && unzip -l "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip | tail -1)" | $(which grep) 'scripts/testing' | node -e 'const rl=require("readline").createInterface({input:process.stdin}); const seen=new Set(); rl.on("line",l=>{const parts=l.trim().split(/\s+/); const path=parts[parts.length-1]; const m=path.match(/scripts\/testing\/([^/]+)/); if(!m) return; let name=m[1].replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""); const seg=name.split("-"); if(seg[0]!=="test" || !seg[1] || !seg[2]) return; const canon=[seg[0],seg[1],seg[2]].join("-"); seen.add(canon);}); rl.on("close",()=>{for(const c of seen) console.log(c);});' | while read tc; do npm run test -- "$tc" $APPVERSION; done; npm run appversion
scripts.filter-tests: npm run appversion && OUTPUT="$(unzip -l "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)"|$(which grep) 'scripts/testing')" bash -c 'awk "{ path=\$NF; n=split(path,a,\"\\/\"); for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if(a[i]==\"scripts\" && a[i+1]==\"testing\" && index(a[i+2],\"test-\")==1) print a[i+2]; }" <<< \"$OUTPUT\"'
scripts.extract-t: unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d .. && v=$(basename $(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip | tail -1));v=${v##*-};v=${v%.zip} && mkdir -p /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && echo "version is unchanged: $(npm pkg get version)" && echo && unzip -l "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)"|$(which grep) 'scripts/testing' >/dev/null && npm run run-tests
scripts.extract-d: v=$(basename $(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip | tail -1));v=${v##*-};v=${v%.zip} && mkdir -p /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && unzip -o "$(/bin/ls -tr /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/*.zip|tail -1)" -d /datavol/$npm_package_name/drop/$v && npm run appversion
scripts.zip: npm run zipsrc-claude && npm run zipdeploy && npm run zipsql && npm run ziptests
scripts.zipall3: npm run zipsrc-claude && npm run zipdeploy && zip /datavol/$npm_package_name/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip /datavol/$npm_package_name/source/*-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.zipall1: rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/data; rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/pgsql; zip -9 -r /datavol/$npm_package_name/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip ../linkedin-agent/ -x "**/LinkedIn_Agent_Testing/*" -x "**/deploy/*" -x "**/migration/*" -x "**/.env" -x "**/docs/*" -x "**/pg.conf" -x "**/.DS_Store" -x "**/*tmp*" -x "**/.psqlrc" -x "**/bashrc-hook.sh" -x "**/*.db*" -x "**/*.nogit*" -x "**/*.nogit*/*" -x "**/*.md" -x "**/.git/*" -x "**/node_modules/*" -x "**/.gitignore" -x "**/*.tar.gz" -x "**/*.log" -x "**/*.zip" -x "**/*.bak*" && echo && echo /datavol/$npm_package_name/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip; cd ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql && ln -s . pgsql && ln -s pgsql data
scripts.zipall2: rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/data; rm ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql/pgsql; zip -9 -r /datavol/$npm_package_name/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip ../linkedin-agent/scripts/testing/ ../linkedin-agent/ ../LinkedIn_Agent_Deploy/ -x "**/migration/*" -x "**/.env" -x "**/docs/*" -x "**/pg.conf" -x "**/.DS_Store" -x "**/*tmp*" -x "**/.psqlrc" -x "**/bashrc-hook.sh" -x "**/*.db*" -x "**/*.nogit*" -x "**/*.nogit*/*" -x "**/*.md" -x "**/.git/*" -x "**/node_modules/*" -x "**/.gitignore" -x "**/*.tar.gz" -x "**/*.log" -x "**/*.zip" -x "**/*.bak*" && echo && echo /datavol/$npm_package_name/source/source-all-$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.zip; cd ../linkedin-agent/data/pgsql && ln -s . pgsql && ln -s pgsql data
scripts.batch-test-bypass: BYPASS_TEST_LIST="test-p3 step 4 test-atest testing 1 test-atest testing 2" bash scripts/testing/batch-run-test.sh
scripts.insert_test_membership: . ./.env.pgsql-marketing_ai_instance.local && psql -c "INSERT INTO memberships (auth_provider, auth_sub, tenant_id, role) VALUES ('auth0', '$TEST_AUTH', '$TENANT_ID', 'owner') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;"
scripts.linkedin-signout: . ./.env.pgsql-marketing_ai_instance.local && psql -c "DELETE FROM credentials WHERE tenant_id = '$TENANT_ID' AND key IN ('linkedin_access_token', 'linkedin_person_urn') OR tenant_id = '$TENANT_ID' AND key IN ('linkedin_access_token', 'linkedin_person_urn');" && npm run build
